newsitem.title: USA: Damen extends closing date on buyback plan.
newsitem.headline: Damen extends closing date on buyback plan.

text.p: Damen Financial Corp said Monday it will delay the closing of its repurchase plan to March 31 from March 27, allowing shareholders the opportunity to receive the company's $0.06 a share dividend.

Late last month, Damen Financial began a self tender for 850,000 shares, which represents 22.5 percent of its 3.77 million outstanding shares, the company said. Under the plan, stockholders can sell part or all of their shares to the corporation at a price of not less than $13.25 a share and not more than $14.75.
Damen has set a dividend of $0.06 per share to shareholders of record as of March 31.

"Even though the company is delaying the closing date of its self tender offer until after March 31, 1997, I want to stress that the anticipated expiration date of the offer remains March 27, 1997," Mary Beth Poronsky Stull, president and chief executive, said in a statement.
"Accordingly, shareholders who do not tender by March 27, 1997 will be afforded the opportunity to participate in the tender offer," she said.
Shares of Damen were unchanged at 14-3/4.
